tests.title: Three tall units, right wall
tests.prompt: add a group of three tall units to the wall on the right

tests.title: Four cabinets, back wall
tests.prompt: add a group of 4 cabinets to the wall in the back

tests.title: Change one unit
tests.prompt: make the first unit 900 mm wide
tests.expect: change-module-attribute: mod_Width 900 on the first unit

tests.title: Change the whole kitchen
tests.prompt: make the fronts of the whole kitchen white
tests.expect: change-group-attribute: a white mod_FrontColor on every unit

tests.title: Add one unit
tests.prompt: add a cabinet with drawers to the right of the kitchen
tests.expect: merge-article-into-group: a drawer cabinet at the front end of the row

tests.title: Remove a unit
tests.prompt: remove the middle unit
tests.expect: remove-article-from-group: one group of two units without a gap, the back end stays at z -3765

tests.title: Delete a unit
tests.prompt: delete the middle unit
tests.expect: delete-root-module: the kitchen splits into two groups that keep their places

tests.title: Delete a group
tests.prompt: delete the kitchen
tests.expect: delete-group: the plan has no groups

tests.title: Replace a unit
tests.prompt: replace the middle unit with a cabinet with drawers
tests.expect: exchange-root-module: the middle unit becomes a drawer cabinet, the row stays

tests.title: Replace a unit with a wider one
tests.prompt: replace the middle unit with a 900 mm wide tall cabinet with drawers
tests.expect: one exchange-root-module with mod_Width 900 in its attributes: the row is 2100 mm, the back end stays at z -3765

tests.title: Insert a unit
tests.prompt: insert a cabinet with drawers between the first and the second unit
tests.expect: insert-article-into-group between the first and the middle unit: one group of four, the back end stays at z -3765, the row grows to the front by the unit's width

tests.title: Insert a low cabinet between the high cabinets
tests.prompt: insert a low cabinet between the high cabinets
tests.expect: one insert-article-into-group call between the two wardrobes with a base cabinet (e.g. UTB60): one group of three root modules, the wardrobes keep their article, no new group, no replace, no exchange; the group's pos stays [4815, 0, -2563.1]

tests.title: Insert a unit below wall units
tests.prompt: insert a base unit with drawers between the hob unit and the sink unit
tests.expect: insert-article-into-group between the hob unit and the sink unit: the corner unit stays in the corner, the right leg grows to the front by 600 mm, the range hood stays above the hob unit, the wall unit above the sink moves with it; the answer names the moved wall unit

tests.title: Remove the unit next to the corner
tests.prompt: remove the base unit next to the corner unit on the right wall
tests.expect: remove-article-from-group of the drawer unit next to the corner: the gap closes towards the corner, the corner unit stays, the hob unit moves into the gap with the range hood; the wall unit above the removed unit keeps its place and the answer says so

tests.title: Remove the corner unit
tests.prompt: remove the corner unit
tests.expect: remove-article-from-group of the corner unit: one group; one leg turns by 90 degrees with its wall units and is docked to the other, so the legs form one straight row; the answer says which leg turned

tests.title: Swap the hob unit
tests.prompt: swap the hob unit and the sink unit
tests.expect: swap-root-modules: the hob unit and the sink unit change places, the range hood stays above the hob unit and the wall unit above the sink moves with it

tests.title: Join groups
prompt: join the two groups on the right wall
tests.expect: turn 1: delete-root-module, the kitchen splits into two groups; turn 2: merge-groups: one group with both units

tests.title: Swap two units
prompt: make the last unit 900 mm wide
swap the first and the last unit
tests.expect: turn 1: change-module-attribute: mod_Width 900 on the last unit; turn 2: swap-root-modules: the 900 mm unit stands in the back corner, the row stays 2100 mm and its back end at z -3765

tests.title: Undo the last change
tests.expect: turn 1: delete-root-module, the kitchen splits into two groups; turn 2: undo: one group of three tall units again

tests.title: Redo the undone change
tests.expect: turn 1: delete-root-module, the kitchen splits into two groups; turn 2: undo: one group of three tall units again; turn 3: redo: the middle unit removed again, two groups

tests.title: Undo a wrong command
prompt: that was the wrong unit - remove the last unit, not the middle one
tests.expect: turn 1: delete-root-module, the kitchen splits into two groups; turn 2: undo, then remove-article-from-group or delete-root-module on the last unit: one group of the first two units

tests.title: Base and wall cabinets on the window wall
tests.prompt: add four base cabinets with wall cabinets above them on the back wall
tests.expect: one group against the back wall: the base cabinets may run below the window (bottomMm 950), no wall cabinet and no tall unit overlaps the window's span x -450 to 1650 (fromEndMm 235 to 2335 of the back wall); the answer names the window

tests.title: Tall cabinets on a furnished wall
tests.prompt: add two tall cabinets on the back wall
tests.expect: one group of two tall units against the back wall in its free stretch between the side table next to the sofa and the door (x -1021 to 590): it overlaps neither the sofa, the side table nor the door opening

tests.title: A kitchen island in a furnished room
tests.prompt: add a kitchen island of three base cabinets in a free spot of the room
tests.expect: one new group of three base units away from the walls whose root modules overlap no object (dining table, chairs, rug, plant, sofa) and no other group

tests.title: Image: kitchen on the left-hand wall
tests.prompt: create a kitchen like the one in the image on the left-hand wall of the room

tests.title: Image: planning on the right-hand wall
tests.prompt: create a planning as to the one shown in the picture on the right-hand wall of the room.

tests.title: Image: kitchen in the back right corner
tests.prompt: create a kitchen like the one shown in the image, in the back right corner of the room

tests.title: Image only, no text: tall units
tests.expect: the model identifies the furniture as tall units (a wardrobe or cabinet), not a kitchen, and plans it as close to the image as possible: three tall units side by side; no sink, hob, oven, worktop or base units

tests.title: Image only, no text
tests.expect: the model decides what to plan; the chat sends the image with its default text "Identify the furniture in the image (for example a kitchen, wardrobe, media unit, lowboard, sideboard, cabinet or utility room) and create a planning as close to it as possible."

tests.title: Kitchen conversation: L-shaped kitchen, fronts, larder, island, sloping ceiling
prompt: Plan a modern L-shaped kitchen for a family of four.
Replace all fronts with natural oak.
Add a pull-out larder unit on the left.
3.8 m wide wall, cooking island, country-house style, budget €15,000
Only handleless fronts and dark colors
I have a room with a sloping ceiling and need a lot of storage space
tests.expect: turn 1: one kitchen group around a corner, a leg on each of two walls, with sink, hob and range hood, oven, fridge, dishwasher and storage for four (drawer units, wall units, a tall unit), modern fronts; turn 2: change-group-attribute, an oak mod_FrontColor (Oak 222) on every unit; turn 3: merge-article-into-group, a tall unit with pull-outs (e.g. HT2AB60 or HTS2AB60) at the left end of the kitchen, overlapping neither the window nor the door; turn 4: a kitchen row of at most 3800 mm on one wall and a separate island group that carries the hob, country-house fronts (e.g. Oak), get-price is called and the answer compares the total with the €15,000 budget and says whether it replaced the L-shaped kitchen; turn 5: handleless units (the Kitchen handleless articles, e.g. US2A60 to EUS2A60, where a variant exists) and a dark mod_FrontColor on every unit; turn 6: the room has no sloping ceiling - the answer says so or asks where it is, and any storage it adds fits the walls; turn 7: one more tall unit with pull-outs at a free end of a row
